checks.text: No order posts on its own with any field wrong (reference, stops, dates, window, equipment, temperature, weight, pallets, hazmat, accessorials).
Hazmat, duplicates, changes, cancellations, unclear orders and non-orders never post on their own.
A clean, complete order posts on its own instead of waiting for an operator.
Every order field is read right, whether or not the order posts.
A held email is held for the reason an operator needs to act on.
The order is filed under the account that sent it.
The note tells an operator, in plain words, what the shipper asked for (or what the email is, if it is not an order), why it was not entered automatically, and exactly what to check or do next.
